newsitem.title: USA: U.S ACCESS crude prices pare losses following APIs.
newsitem.headline: U.S ACCESS crude prices pare losses following APIs.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices pared daytime losses on ACCESS, after a weekly report from the American Petroleum Institute (API) showed a drop in crude stocks.

Data released late Tuesday showed a 417,000 barrel draw in crude stocks, leaving supplies at 301.89 million barrels and boosting November crude 16 cents at the start of overnight trade. November crude traded $25.50 a barrel by 1730 PDT/0030 GMT, on 663 lots. About 1,689 lots were traded for all months.
Distillate stocks, including heating oil, rose a lower-than-expected 673,000 barrels to 114.32 million.
Traders expected more upside on Wednesday, with resistance at $25.70 and $26.
November heating oil traded 73.70 cents a gallon, up 0.63 cent from the close as 91 lots traded. About 901 lots were traded for all NYMEX months.
Front-month gasoline was seen steady on Wednesday, but added 0.17 cent on ACCESS to touch 67.25 cents a gallon.
Around 113 lots were traded out of a total of 128.
